summary: visual.md survives on its core architecture. These all check out against the frozen v46 CSS, the boards and 1b090c9: the B1-10 root cause and the selector '@container xr-content (max-width:759.98px){ .xr-table thead{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}' in xr-foundation.css; the focusable 'Received' header button and its duplicated name 'Received, Received, newest first. Change order'; app widths below 808 px (content = app - 48 in drawer mode), plus 1024-1071 with the sidebar expanded; Preflight being included by @import 'tailwindcss' and the theme.css/utilities.css import without Preflight working in tailwindcss 4.3.3; 65 tokens, 11 read through var(), 89 @container blocks, reduced motion as the only @media rule, and 24,319 style attributes; the responsive shell thresholds; no DEMO banner and no Slice-1 UI; and the new variances V-1, V-2, V-3 and V-5. A Chromium 152 check confirmed PF-03/PF-04: position:fixed inside an inline-size container stays fixed to the viewport, and container queries still match inside a showModal() dialog. Refuted or corrected: (1) B1-13 does NOT repeat the defect: its SA-02 instance is a 1440-px thumbnail scaled 0.3 inside an aria-hidden, inert wrapper, so the thead is not clipped and nothing is focusable. (2) ErrorSummary evidence is wrong: xw-errsum is not drawn on the cited Batch-0 boards, which draw xr-notice--err instead. The 47 'unlinked' B5 summaries navigate with per-item buttons (ul.xv-miss); only 30 instances, on B2-05, B2-07, B2-14 and B3-08, lack navigation. (3) The visual-regression plan cannot run as described: there is no git remote, no CI config and no Docker here; vendored-file provenance is unspecified; and CORS on route.fulfill is needed for the SRI scripts. (4) §11 leaves room for a developer switcher, which conflicts with the owner constraint. Minor items: per-sheet layers invert cross-sheet specificity (use one xr.v46 layer); PF-06 is a confirmed need; and several counts and citations are off (decision IDs 298 not 316, plus T-08; static panels 71 not 65; keepLabel 47 not ~30; hub tabs 67; and others).

corrections.problem: Putting each of the 8 sheets in its own layer does more than 'preserve the B8-07 internal order'. A later sheet's lower-specificity rule then beats an earlier sheet's higher-specificity rule, which the boards (unlayered sheets) never do, so verbatim CSS no longer yields verbatim cascade. Also, the layer-order statement exists only in @xr/ui index.css, so the order of utilities depends on CSS chunk order.
corrections.evidence: Static pair scan of the 8 sheets (rules with shared properties whose subject classes co-occur on board elements) found 15 inversion candidates. The realistic one: xr-foundation.css '.xr-btn[disabled],.xr-btn[aria-disabled="true"]{background:#EEF0F8;border-color:#E1E4F3;color:#5C6389;…}' (0,2,0) vs xr-govern.css '.xg-del{color:#B42318}' (0,1,0). The boards draw 'xr-btn xr-btn--text xg-del' (31x), and the product busy state sets aria-disabled. Unlayered gives grey; with xr.foundation < xr.govern it stays red.
corrections.correction: Import all 8 verbatim sheets into ONE layer in B8-07 order, e.g. '@layer theme, xr.v46, xr.product, utilities;' then '@import "./v46/xr-foundation.css" layer(xr.v46); … @import "./v46/xr-admin.css" layer(xr.v46);'. That reproduces the boards' cascade exactly while product and utilities still win. Repeat the identical '@layer …;' statement as the first line of apps/web/src/app/globals.css so the order holds whichever file is emitted first.
